questions.prompt: Who was the first person to reach the summit of Everest with Tenzing Norgay?

questions.fact: It was introduced in 1970 to stop sets running indefinitely, which had been making scheduling impossible.

questions.prompt: Which band is known for the album Definitely Maybe?
questions.fact: It became the fastest-selling debut album in British history when released in 1994.

questions.prompt: Which US state produces the most oil?
questions.fact: It alone would rank among the largest oil-producing countries in the world.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novel The Poisonwood Bible?
questions.fact: It is narrated in rotation by a mother and her four daughters, each with a distinct voice.
